notes: Per FLUXMET annual site-year: NEE qualification (qualifies_VUT/CUT, category) joined to that year's BIF u-star method success flags (cp_success/mp_success: 1=success, 0=failure, NA=no BIF record for that site-year -- method-run years in the BIF file don't always align 1:1 with annual-table years, e.g. a method can be run for a calendar year with no corresponding FLUXMET annual row, or vice versa).
